title: Ordered Ramsey numbers of 3-uniform hypergraphs with bounded weak degeneracy
summary: The \emph{ordered Ramsey number} $r_ 0$ such that, for every integer $d\ge1$, there is a constant $C_d>0$ for which every weakly $d$-degenerate ordered $3$-graph $H$ on $t$ vertices satisfies \[ r_ 2^{Ω(n^2)}.$
